memories.content: Daniel Reyes told me his younger sister Camille lives in Porto.
I'm married to Ana, and we've been together since 2015.
My dog Biscuit is a beagle who hates the rain.
Hal Brennan in Accounts approves my expense reports every Friday.
Prof. Elena Vasquez supervised my thesis at the University of Lisbon, and she still reviews my drafts.
Tomas moved to Lyon in June.
She moved to Lyon last spring and loves the bakeries there.
Maya is my sister. She moved to Lyon last spring.
Ravi doesn't live in Berlin anymore; he relocated to Munich.
Not Bob, but Alice manages the Helix platform team.
Alice, not Bob, is the on-call lead for Atlas.
Dr. Ingrid Sørensen is my GP in Oslo.
Priya's birthday is 14 March, and she wants pancakes, not cake.
Mum lives in Cork with her sister Eilis.
I don't like Marcus Hale's cooking shows; too much shouting.
Eilis and her husband Conor just bought a house in Galway.
Our daughter Lea started kindergarten on 2026-09-01.
Sam and I went to Kyoto in April 2024 for my cousin's wedding.
My manager Lucia Ferrer approved the trip to Kyoto.
Fiona is a friend of mine from university; we still play chess on Sundays.
I work at Northwind Labs as a data engineer.
Daniel Reyes works at Brightline Health and reports to Mira Chen.
Since March 3, 2026 I've been on the Orion team under Jun Park.
Jun Park no longer manages me; the reorg moved me to Orion.
Sofia Lind joined Northwind Labs in January.
Northwind Labs is not my current employer; I left in August.
My former boss Kenji Ito retired from Halcyon in 2025.
Priya Raman is the product lead for Halcyon's search team.
Mira Chen manages the platform group, and Jun Park is on her team.
Hiroshi and Lena both work in the Berlin office of Quanta Systems.
Dmitri reports to Lucia Ferrer, not to Mira Chen.
I'm a contractor, not a full-time employee, at Quanta Systems.
Elena works as a nurse in Porto.
After the merger, Halcyon's platform team now sits under Quanta Systems.
Trabalho na Quanta Systems desde março.
Mi hermana Maya vive en Lyon desde 2025.
I live in Ghent now, not Antwerp.
Biscuit and I moved to Coimbra in 2022.
Lea was born in Toronto but has never lived there.
Mira Chen relocated from Seattle to Vancouver last year.
Camille's new flat in Porto is near the river, which she loves.
I rent a studio in Florence, but my permanent address is still Milan.
Quanta Systems opened a new office in Austin.
Konstantin is from Kraków and speaks Polish at home.
O Daniel mudou-se para Coimbra em 2024.
The trip to Lisbon was booked for the week of 2026-04-06.
I prefer Neovim to VS Code for Rust work.
I dislike Notion; it makes me slow.
Dmitri likes Grafana dashboards more than anything else.
I'm not a fan of Jira. Linear is fine.
Fiona can't stand Microsoft Teams calls.
Maya loves Lyon's food scene.
I always pick Postgres over MySQL for new services.
Sam doesn't use Slack anymore; they moved everything to Matrix.
Ana loves cycling but hates running in winter.
I'd rather use Tailwind than plain CSS for dashboards.
Daniel Reyes can't work without Docker on his laptop.
Ich wohne in Berlin, nicht in München.
I stopped using Spotify in May; now I use Apple Music.
Je travaille chez Halcyon depuis 2024.
We picked Rust for Atlas because of memory safety.
Decision: Atlas will store embeddings in sqlite-vec, not Qdrant.
Helix runs on Kubernetes 1.31 in the eu-west cluster.
The Helix dashboard is at https://helix.example.internal/status.
Atlas ingestion now runs from /srv/atlas/ingest/worker.py.
Priya Raman deployed Atlas v2.3.1 to staging on 2026-10-02.
We chose PostgreSQL over CockroachDB because the team already knows it.
Orion's auth service depends on Keycloak 24.
I installed ripgrep 14.1 and fd 10 with cargo install.
The quill repo is at github.com/example-lab/quill, branch main.
Quill's CI runs on GitHub Actions, and releases go to crates.io.
I switched Helix's logging from Fluentd to Vector last week.
Hal Brennan says Atlas will not ship without the migration tests.
Dmitri's PR for Atlas was merged on 2026-09-14.
Quanta Systems is now the parent company of Halcyon.
Helix moved from Heroku to Fly.io in 2025.
Lucia Ferrer approved the budget for Atlas and Helix.
The neocortex MCP server exposes eight tools over stdio.
I'm building a CLI called tidy for personal finance.
Team decided to pin sqlite-vec at 0.1.9 because 0.1.10-alpha fails to compile.
Maya's startup, Lumen Labs, is hiring Rust developers.
Our Q4 budget review is titled 'Budget Review 2026 Q4' with Lucia.
Ravi asked to use Helix's staging database, but Mira said no.

Kickoff for Helix phase two happened on 12 January 2026 in Lisbon.
Daniel Reyes was promoted to staff engineer on 2025-11-01.
Biscuit had surgery at the Lisbon Vet Clinic on 2026-02-14.
Mira Chen will present the Atlas roadmap at the 2026-11-05 offsite.
In 2024 Fiona won the Lisbon Half Marathon.
Elena's retirement party is on 30 April 2027.

Yesterday Priya and I shipped the search reindex.
Last week, Hiroshi left Quanta Systems for Vanta.
Camille got her PhD from the University of Porto in 2021.
Eilis moved in with Conor on 2024-04-01.

Grafana dashboards for Helix are under the ops folder.

Fly.io machines for Helix are sized shared-cpu-2x; see fly.toml.
The docs site runs on Astro 4.16 and deploys from main.

Our cat Pixel hates the vacuum. He sleeps on my keyboard.
